description: This file defines a set of data transfer objects (DTOs) used for the dashboard feature in a Spring Boot backend application. It contains records representing various responses and data points such as severity distribution, overdue actions, trend points, and defect trends.

classes.name: SeverityDistributionResponse
classes.description: A record representing the distribution of defect severities with a map from severity levels to counts.

classes.name: OverdueActionsResponse
classes.description: A record representing the count of overdue actions.

classes.name: TrendPoint
classes.description: A record representing a data point in a trend, with a time period and a count.

classes.name: DefectTrendResponse
classes.description: A record containing a list of trend points indicating defect trends over time.
